details: The scrollytelling pattern is sound — IntersectionObserver fires only on step entry (not every scroll tick) and the tooltip uses the unified Pointer Events API. However, `renderState` starts new D3 transitions via `svgEl.transition()` without calling `.interrupt()` first, so rapid scrolling between steps mid-flight will cause conflicting transitions and 'snapping' elements on bars, lines, and opacity-animated annotation groups.
